description: This PHP source file defines a test double class 'FakeCalendarSyncJobCleaner' that inherits from 'CalendarSyncJobCleaner'. It provides in-memory tracking of calendar synchronization job cancellations for testing purposes, replacing database interactions with in-memory data structures and methods for verification.

classes.name: FakeCalendarSyncJobCleaner
classes.description: A test double class used to simulate and track calendar sync job cancellations without interacting with a database.

methods.name: cancelPendingMeetingJobs
methods.description: Records a cancellation attempt in-memory and returns a configurable number of jobs to cancel.

methods.name: setJobsToCancel
methods.description: Configures how many cancellation jobs should be reported as canceled.

methods.name: wasCancelCalled
methods.description: Checks if any cancellation operations were recorded.

methods.name: getCancellationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of recorded cancellations.

methods.name: getLastCancelledOperation
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent cancellation operation, if any.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal cancellation records and counters.
